findings.finding: New CEO Jo McNamara (in post since 14 Sep) uses her first results to set out her agenda; in October she flagged 'ensuring the business is as efficient as possible and allocating capital to deliver the best returns', so a cost-efficiency or capital-allocation announcement is plausible at the half-year.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior new-CEO results for this name in the baseline window; the 15 Oct statement carrying her first comments moved +3.58%, but that day also carried the pre-release of the half.
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing quantified has been disclosed, so no figure can be priced. Had the market priced an efficiency target, the stock would have re-rated toward the 599p NTA rather than sitting at ~433p (a ~28% discount). This is inference from one sentence: a new CEO can also reset expectations lower, hence the wide range and a small centre.

findings.finding: Seasonality arithmetic on the company's own numbers: H1 EPS 16.1p is 52.8% of the 'at least 30.5p' FY27 floor against 53.5% last year (15.4p of 28.8p implied by '6% growth'), so H2 needs ~14.4p (+7.7% y/y) just to hit the floor; a raise of the FY27 guide is not implied by the half and reiteration is the likely outcome.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance reiterated at HY26 (19 Nov 2025, -0.74%) and at FY26 (20 May 2026, +2.38%); no raise or cut in the observed history.
findings.why_not_priced: The 12% LFL rental growth and 'strong first half' headline invite hopes of an upgrade; the arithmetic that the half does not support one is not in the wire copy. If it were fully priced, the stock would not have extended +3.6% over 20 days into the print. Small because the company reiterated the guide in October with the half already known.
findings.independence: Landsec, reporting 13 Nov, also reiterated its current-year guide (stable EPS) and moved its outlook only for the following year: https://www.directorstalkinterviews.com/landsec-raises-fy28-earnings-growth-outlook-following-611m-retail-acquisitions/4121269682
